passages.translationText: 79.] In point of form Logical doctrine has three sides: (α) the Abstract side, or that of understanding: (ß) the Dialectical, or that of negative reason: (y) the Speculative, or that of positive reason. These three sides do not make three parts of logic, but are stages or 'moments' in every logical entity, that is, of every notion and truth whatever. They may all be put under the first stage, that of understanding, and so kept isolated from each other; but this would give an inadequate conception of them.
passages.interpretiveNote: 知性、否定的辩证理性和肯定的思辨理性不是可以机械套用的三个外部步骤，而是每个概念和真理自身包含的三个环节。
